<!doctype html><html lang="ko"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>AX Action Camp 3기 · 해커톤 아이디어 접수</title><style>
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;min-height:100%;font-family:Pretendard,"Noto Sans KR",Arial,sans-serif;background:#020714;color:#fff}body{background:radial-gradient(circle at 78% 16%,rgba(45,114,255,.20),transparent 26%),linear-gradient(#020714,#05112c 65%,#020611)}.app{max-width:1600px;min-height:100vh;margin:auto;padding:22px 28px 88px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.08fr .92fr;gap:28px;align-items:center}.poster{width:100%;aspect-ratio:745/858;background:url(data:image/jpeg;base64,) center/contain no-repeat;border-radius:22px;filter:drop-shadow(0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.32))}.panel{min-height:760px;border:1px solid #2d98ff;border-radius:26px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(3,16,42,.97),rgba(2,10,28,.98));box-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(26,127,255,.25),inset 0 0 35px rgba(43,107,255,.06);padding:28px 32px;position:relative}.head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:8px 4px 22px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(84,155,255,.25);font-size:22px;font-weight:900}.head b{color:#52d9ff}.tag{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:#a8bbd8;border:1px solid #315d92;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap}.nodes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);margin:26px 4px 0;position:relative}.nodes:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:6%;right:6%;top:20px;height:1px;background:#244f82}.node{z-index:1;margin:auto;width:41px;height:41px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#07152f;border:1px solid #536a8d;color:#7f92b0;font-size:13px}.node.active{color:#fff;border-color:#5de2ff;box-shadow:0 0 18px #178cff;background:#123b78}.node.done{color:#bff3ff;border-color:#46cfff;background:#0b2752}.count{margin:14px 8px;color:#c6d3e8;font-weight:700}.box{margin-top:15px;min-height:470px;border:1px solid rgba(74,151,255,.28);border-radius:18px;padding:30px 28px 90px;background:rgba(3,13,34,.62);position:relative}.step{display:none}.step.active{display:block}.meta{color:#56dcff;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em;margin-bottom:14px}h2{font-size:30px;line-height:1.35;margin:0 0 12px;letter-spacing:-.04em}.desc{color:#91a6c8;line-height:1.7;font-size:14px;margin:0 0 25px}.input{display:block;border:1px solid #3d78c4;border-radius:15px;background:#071b43;padding:5px 15px}input,textarea{width:100%;border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;color:#fff;font:inherit;font-size:18px;padding:15px 3px}textarea{min-height:150px;resize:vertical;line-height:1.7}input::placeholder,textarea::placeholder{color:#526887}.opts{display:grid;gap:13px}.opt{padding:18px;border:1px solid #315c91;border-radius:15px;background:#071933;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;cursor:pointer}.opt.sel{border-color:#59d8ff;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(23,128,255,.2),rgba(135,89,255,.18));box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(45,156,255,.2)}.radio{width:23px;height:23px;border:1px solid #667fa7;border-radius:50%}.sel .radio{border:6px solid #58d9ff}.err{color:#ff9cac;font-size:12px;min-height:20px;margin-top:9px}.actions{position:absolute;left:28px;right:28px;bottom:24px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between}.btn{border-radius:12px;border:1px solid transparent;padding:14px 22px;font-weight:900;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}.prev{color:#b5c2d8;background:#101a2c}.next{min-width:175px;color:#fff;border-color:#45c6ff;background:linear-gradient(#0d3d86,#09245a);box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(32,145,255,.35)}.summary{display:grid;gap:9px;max-height:290px;overflow:auto}.sum{padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid #203d66;border-radius:11px;background:#06162f}.sum span{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#7e94b6;margin-bottom:5px}.done{text-align:center;padding:36px 10px}.check{width:96px;height:96px;margin:0 auto 22px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:44px;border:1px solid #56d9ff;box-shadow:0 0 28px #177fff}.done h3{font-size:34px;margin:0 0 12px}.done p{color:#a5b5ce;line-height:1.8}.footer{position:fixed;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);bottom:14px;width:min(1260px,calc(100% - 56px));height:56px;border:1px solid #315f9c;border-radius:16px;background:#061733ef;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:15px;z-index:5}.footer b{color:#38caff}.logo{position:absolute;right:22px;font-size:24px;font-weight:900}.logo span{color:#38caff}@media(max-width:1100px){.app{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:18px 18px 28px}.poster{max-height:560px}.panel{max-width:900px;margin:auto;width:100%}.footer{position:static;transform:none;margin:12px auto 22px}}@media(max-width:620px){.app{padding:10px}.poster{border-radius:14px}.panel{min-height:690px;padding:18px 14px}.head{font-size:17px}.tag{display:none}.node{width:34px;height:34px;font-size:11px}.nodes:before{top:17px}.box{min-height:460px;padding:22px 16px 88px}h2{font-size:24px}.actions{left:16px;right:16px}.next{min-width:130px}.footer{font-size:12px;width:calc(100% - 20px);padding-right:52px;text-align:center}.logo{right:10px;font-size:18px}}
</style></head><body><div class="app"><div class="poster" aria-label="AX Action Camp 3기 포스터"></div><section class="panel"><div class="head"><div><b>AX ACTION CAMP 3기</b> · 해커톤 아이디어 접수</div><div class="tag">DIRECT STORE · HACKATHON</div></div><div class="nodes"><div class="node active">01</div><div class="node">02</div><div class="node">03</div><div class="node">04</div><div class="node">05</div><div class="node">06</div></div><div class="count">1 / 6</div><div class="box"><div class="step active"><div class="meta">MISSION 01 · PROFILE</div><h2>01. 이름을 입력해주세요.</h2><p class="desc">해커톤 참가자 확인을 위해 사용됩니다.</p><label class="input"><input id="name" placeholder="이름을 입력해주세요" maxlength="30"></label><div class="err"></div></div><div class="step"><div class="meta">MISSION 02 · STORE</div><h2>02. 점포명을 입력해주세요.</h2><p class="desc">현재 근무 중인 직영 점포명을 작성해주세요.</p><label class="input"><input id="store" placeholder="예) 인천공항T2출국점" maxlength="50"></label><div class="err"></div></div><div class="step"><div class="meta">MISSION 03 · TEAM</div><h2>03. 해커톤 팀 이름을 입력해주세요.</h2><p class="desc">현장에서 사용한 팀명 그대로 작성해주세요.</p><label class="input"><input id="team" placeholder="예) AI 탐험대" maxlength="50"></label><div class="err"></div></div><div class="step"><div class="meta">MISSION 04 · TITLE</div><h2>04. 주제 제목을 입력해주세요.</h2><p class="desc">아이디어의 핵심이 한눈에 보이도록 간결하게 작성해주세요.</p><label class="input"><input id="title" placeholder="예) 직영점 운영정보 AI 챗봇" maxlength="80"></label><div class="err"></div></div><div class="step"><div class="meta">MISSION 05 · DESCRIPTION</div><h2>05. 주제를 설명해주세요.</h2><p class="desc">어떤 문제를 해결하고 어떻게 활용할 수 있는지 자유롭게 작성해주세요.</p><label class="input"><textarea id="description" placeholder="주제 설명을 입력해주세요" maxlength="700"></textarea></label><div class="err"></div></div><div class="step"><div class="meta">MISSION 06 · GOODS</div><h2>06. 해커톤 굿즈를 수령하셨나요?</h2><p class="desc">현재 기준으로 선택해주세요.</p><div class="opts"><div class="opt" data-v="수령했습니다"><span>네, 수령했습니다.</span><span class="radio"></span></div><div class="opt" data-v="아직 수령하지 못했습니다"><span>아니요, 아직 수령하지 못했습니다.</span><span class="radio"></span></div></div><input id="goods" type="hidden"><div class="err"></div></div><div class="step"><div class="meta">FINAL CHECK · REVIEW</div><h2>입력한 내용을 확인해주세요.</h2><p class="desc">수정이 필요하면 이전 버튼으로 돌아갈 수 있습니다.</p><div class="summary"></div><div class="err"></div></div><div class="step"><div class="done"><div class="check">✓</div><h3>MISSION COMPLETE</h3><p>해커톤 아이디어 접수가 완료되었습니다.<br>여러분의 아이디어가 GS25의 혁신을 만듭니다.</p></div></div><div class="actions"><button class="btn prev">← 이전</button><button class="btn next">다음 →</button></div></div></section></div><div class="footer">여러분의 아이디어가&nbsp;<b>GS25의 혁신</b>을 만듭니다!<div class="logo">GS<span>25</span></div></div><script>const s=[...document.querySelectorAll('.step')],n=[...document.querySelectorAll('.node')],nx=document.querySelector('.next'),pv=document.querySelector('.prev'),ct=document.querySelector('.count'),sm=document.querySelector('.summary'),a=document.querySelector('.actions');let c=0;const f=[['name','이름'],['store','점포명'],['team','해커톤 팀이름'],['title','주제 제목'],['description','주제 설명'],['goods','해커톤 굿즈 수령 여부']];document.querySelectorAll('.opt').forEach(o=>o.onclick=()=>{document.querySelectorAll('.opt').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('sel'));o.classList.add('sel');document.getElementById('goods').value=o.dataset.v});function val(){if(c>5)return 1;let e=document.getElementById(f[c][0]),r=s[c].querySelector('.err');if(!e.value.trim()){r.textContent='이 항목은 필수입니다.';e.focus?.();return 0}r.textContent='';return 1}function sum(){sm.innerHTML=f.map(x=>`<div class="sum"><span>${x[1]}</span><strong>${document.getElementById(x[0]).value.replace(/[<>]/g,'')}</strong></div>`).join('')}function ren(){s.forEach((x,i)=>x.classList.toggle('active',i===c));n.forEach((x,i)=>{x.classList.toggle('active',i===c);x.classList.toggle('done',i<c)});ct.textContent=c<6?`${c+1} / 6`:c===6?'FINAL CHECK':'COMPLETE';pv.style.visibility=c?'visible':'hidden';nx.textContent=c===6?'제출하기 ✓':'다음 →';a.style.display=c===7?'none':'flex';if(c===6)sum()}const SHEETS_ENDPOINT='https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbyfr2thwiCL1oucDcaNbPd1JVB_L8KpjIpnqYMNUk-vsxwHYDHKTPp7d0XdU0h2SQRFWA/exec';let submitting=false;function collect(){const d={};f.forEach(x=>d[x[0]]=document.getElementById(x[0]).value.trim());d.ts=new Date().toISOString();return d}async function submitToSheet(data){await fetch(SHEETS_ENDPOINT,{method:'POST',mode:'no-cors',headers:{'Content-Type':'text/plain;charset=utf-8'},body:JSON.stringify(data)})}nx.onclick=async()=>{if(!val())return;if(c===6){if(submitting)return;submitting=true;nx.disabled=true;nx.textContent='제출 중…';try{await submitToSheet(collect());c=7;ren()}catch(err){s[6].querySelector('.err').textContent='제출 중 문제가 발생했습니다. 잠시 후 다시 시도해주세요.';nx.disabled=false;nx.textContent='제출하기 ✓'}finally{submitting=false}return}if(c<7){c++;ren()}};pv.onclick=()=>{if(c){c--;ren()}};ren();</script></body></html>
